summary: Blue Ridge Bankshares filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with HomeTrust Bancshares and its subsidiary Kinloch Merger Sub. Each Blue Ridge share converts into 0.086 HomeTrust shares plus cash for fractional shares. Boards of both companies unanimously approved the deal. Concurrently, Blue Ridge entered a warrant conversion agreement for cashless exercise of warrants before closing; other warrant holders may elect similar conversion by September 19, 2026. Outstanding unexercised warrants will be assumed by HomeTrust. The merger structure involves a two-step merger with bank subsidiaries merging. Regulatory approvals and shareholder votes are required. What to watch: timing of proxy filings, regulatory clearance, and warrant holder elections.
